title: Location compliance orchestrator and snapshot export
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Ship a tenant-facing control plane that allows customers using the Hosted API to assert a location guarantee (region anchoring), configure per-tenant retention policies, and request cryptographically signed compliance snapshots for audit evidence. Scope includes API surface (CRUD for residency & retention), Console UX for configuration and export, backend enforcement in routing and storage layers, and an automated evidence bundler that compiles signed manifests, routing logs, retention application traces, and redacted request samples for auditors.
acceptance_criteria: API: tenant residency and retention endpoints (create/update/get/delete) with RBAC check and audit trail
Console: configuration flow that guides customers through region selection, retention profile, and fallback behavior; success state and warnings for unsupported contracts
Enforcement: runtime routing honors tenant pin for all new requests and annotates fallback events with reason codes
Retention: retention controls propagate to storage lifecycle jobs and show applied timestamp in audit log

Evidence export: one-click snapshot that produces a signed bundle (manifest, routing traces, retention application logs, policy hashes) suitable for external audit — generated within SLA (<= 10 minutes)
Telemetry: dashboard that surfaces population of pinned tenants, pinned-region health, fallback rates, and evidence export history
Security: evidence bundle contains PII redaction and KMS signature; security review completed and signed off
Tests: E2E test verifies a pinned tenant stays in-region for a canary traffic pattern and that automated snapshot contains the expected artifacts
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya P: Scoping pass complete. Key questions: allowed fallback semantics (soft vs strict), retention granularity (per-route vs tenant-wide), and evidence bundle format. Logged initial risks around cross-region logs used for traces.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Cross-region tracing could leak sensitive metadata. Mitigation: enforce redaction pipeline and restrict raw logs in evidence bundle to PII-free traces only.

Risk: Large tenants could generate very large evidence bundles. Mitigation: incremental snapshotting and signed manifests with object references + optional on-demand retrieval; include size estimates in UI before export.
Risk: Misconfigured pinning could cause availability regressions. Mitigation: default to soft-failover for initial rollout and provide automatic canary and rollback hooks in rollout plan.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): Feature-flagged for Redwood internal orgs; collect telemetry and run simulated cross-region traffic tests.
Phase 2 (pilot): Invite 3 existing hosted customers (non-critical workloads) to opt into pinned tenancy; run nightly evidence snapshot exports and gather audit feedback.
Phase 3 (general availability): Open to all tenants with UI, API docs, and an SLA addendum; enable HSM signing for enterprise tier and baked-in retention verification jobs.
